metadata.title: Density Pass 35 -- Devil's Den and Vincent's Brigade (Ticks 260-272)
metadata.description: The fight for Devil's Den and the rocky ground at the base of Little Round Top. Hood's division attacking. The Texas Brigade and Law's Alabama regiments. Vincent's V Corps brigade rushed to Little Round Top just in time. Vincent himself mortally wounded directing his men. Hazlett's battery hauled up the rocky slope. The race for the summit.

placements.notes: 1st Texas -- Hood's Texas Brigade leading the assault toward Devil's Den and Little Round Top
4th Texas charging with the 1st -- Hood's finest brigade
5th Texas on the right -- driving toward the Round Tops
Law's 4th Alabama -- flanking toward Little Round Top. Law has found it unoccupied.
Vincent's V Corps brigade running up the Baltimore Pike toward Little Round Top -- Meade's aide has found it empty
1st Texas at Devil's Den -- driving Ward's Union brigade from the boulders
Ward's III Corps brigade retreating from Devil's Den -- the boulders are lost
Vincent's brigade at the double-quick up the rocky slope -- arriving seconds before Law
Law's brigade reaching the base of Little Round Top -- the race is seconds
Vincent's brigade deploying on Little Round Top -- 83rd PA, 44th NY, 16th MI, 20th ME. Vincent: Hold this ground at all costs.
Hazlett's Battery D, 5th US -- being manhandled up the rocky slope by brute force. No road.
Texas Brigade assaulting Little Round Top -- Vincent's men waiting behind the rocks
Vincent's brigade holding the crest -- Vincent riding the line. Moments later he is shot.
Texas Brigade repulsed on the left of Vincent's line -- 44th NY and 83rd PA holding
Vincent's brigade still holding -- Vincent mortally wounded, Strong Vincent, this is the fifth time today I've ordered you forward.
Hazlett's guns now in action on the summit -- firing over Vincent's men into Hood's division below
